customrecordtype.description: Staging record for AI-extracted action items awaiting rep approval. One row per action item from LLM analysis. Approve → materializes into native Task. Source of truth for the AI Task Queue surface.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Source Phone Call
customrecordcustomfield.description: The Phone Call record this proposed task was extracted from.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Action Item Text
customrecordcustomfield.description: The LLM-extracted action item text. Editable by rep before approval.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Proposed Due Date
customrecordcustomfield.description: Default = source call date + 3 days. Editable before approval.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Proposed Assignee
customrecordcustomfield.description: Default = call owner. Editable before approval.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Reviewer
customrecordcustomfield.description: Employee who approved or rejected this proposed task.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Materialized Task
customrecordcustomfield.description: Native Task created on approval. Set once on Approve, never edited. selectrecordtype -21 = TASK (NetSuite built-in record type code). -10 is Item, -22 is Phone Call, -4 is Employee.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Task Completed
customrecordcustomfield.description: Sync field — flipped T when the materialized Task is marked Completed. Drives AI Completion Rate metric.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Task Completed Date
customrecordcustomfield.description: When task_completed was synced to T.
